correctness.rationale: Using a separately implemented oriented Abrams cubical model, obtained 96 one-cells, 72 two-cells for unordered 2 points on K4,4, and signed B_2 (96x72). Constructed 18 antisymmetric four-cycle products T and six relation columns S independently of package code: BT=0, TS=0, rank_F3(B)=60, det of specified 12x12 torus minor = +1 and det of specified 6x6 relation minor = -1. Hence over Q kernel rank=12 and both sublattices are primitive over Z; T spans entire integral kernel and the six S vectors form the entire integral kernel of T. The graph subdivision conditions are met for two particles. Not the ordered configuration space.
